newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch April producer prices rise 2.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch April producer prices rise 2.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Dutch producer price index (PPI) for manufactured goods rose a provisional 0.7 percent in April from March, giving a 2.1 percent rise year-on-year, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
DUTCH PRODUCER PRICES April 97 March 97 April 96
Prices in the food and drinks industry rose 2.8 percent in April, mainly because of increased prices within the meat processing industry.
Prices of pork rose 22 percent as the swine fever outbreak reduced supply. Ignoring the meat processing industry, producer prices would have been unchanged month-on-month, the CBS said.
Prices of oil products fell by 3.6 percent in April to a decrease in world crude oil prices, the CBS said.
Prices of commodities and semi-finished products rose by 1.0 percent month-on-month as agricultural produce prices gained.
